tldr: Mercury through the 3rd house brings focus to communication, learning, siblings, neighbors, and daily movement.
body: Mercury transiting the 3rd house activates communication, learning, siblings, neighbors, and daily movement. For a few weeks, thought, conversation, planning, and messages move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a thinking transit: it favors planning, conversations, edits, decisions, and information-gathering around the house topic.
business: Mercury supports writing, messaging, and local connection: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Overthinking, mixed messages, or scattered attention or reactive speech.
advice: Name the details in the 3rd house deliberately. Work with communication, learning, siblings, neighbors, and daily movement without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from Marie Satori house-transit material.
